# index.ejs references them as "<%= vendor %>/<name>@<version>/<path>": jsDelivr's layout, so local
# development loads the same files from jsDelivr. formio-cdn.txt maps the libraries formio loads at
# runtime to files in these packages. The image build (vendor.js) downloads each package from the npm
# registry, checks it against the integrity below and copies only the referenced files, plus what their
# CSS loads (fonts, images).
#
# To update a package: change the version here and where it is referenced, and take the new integrity from
#   npm view <name>@<version> dist.integrity
